pr_comments:
Drive by comment:

`injectArgs` is shared among VE and Ivy, so pulling in `injectAttribute` would probably be a major size regression in VE as it would be referencing Ivy instructions.

*Edit*: it's not too bad, just the single instruction and some Ivy state getters. Still, no Ivy instructions should be referenced from VE code.

Additionally, given that this usage pattern should be really rare, I would like to explore a design where the injectAttribute is patched onto the `Attribute` decorator somehow, so that it's only referenced when the decorator survives. This should allow tree-shaking of `injectAttribute` for the common case. Notice that there's also FW-490 which may interact with this PR, although I'm not sure what the plan is on that Jira.

Any news on when this might make it into release? Lack of Attribute support blocks my migration into Ivy on several projects :( Not that they are big, but still a bummer :) Thanks for a quick pickup, by the way!

Hi @waterplea, thanks for reporting the issue.

We are looking for a more optimized way of handing this (to allow for better tree-shaking), so it may take a bit more time. If that's the only blocker for you to transition to Ivy, may be check if you could avoid using `Attribute` in `deps` array for now and revert it back to the `Attribute` once solution is developed and the fix is released.

Thank you.

I use it in directives declaring some DI items for the lower views and it's the only way to customize it. I used this technique in quite a lot of my open source libraries for native APIs: ng-web-apis.github.io

I can query ElementRef.nativeElement, of course, but that's such a hack :-(

issue_context.title: Attribute in deps stopped working with Ivy
issue_context.body:
# 🐞 bug report ### Affected Package The issue is caused by package @angular/core ### Is this a regression? Yes, the previous version in which this bug was not present was: 8 ### Description You can use `Attribute` decorator in `deps` for providers like this: ``` { provide: TOKEN, deps: [[new Attribute('token')]], useFactory: factory, } ``` It stopped working with Ivy and Angular 9 ## 🔬 Minimal Reproduction Working Angular 8: https://stackblitz.com/edit/angular-attribute-deps Broken Angular 9: https://ng-run.com/edit/hyppU3cXJCaRYLYVDAQp ## 🔥 Exception or Error 

R3InjectorError(AppModule)[[object Object] -> [object Object] -> [object Object]]: 
  NullInjectorError: No provider for [object Object]!
## 🌍 Your Environment **Angular Version:** 
9.1.0
